current_target: LAB-006 (5-day excess return, corrected for dividends)
target_formulation: Excess return vs equal-weight universe median

cross_sectional_ranking.details: Used throughout Phases 9-13C. Cross-sectional ranking within universe is the primary target.

directional_prediction.details: Implicit in IC evaluation — positive IC means model assigns higher scores to stocks that outperform.

absolute_return_prediction.details: ORBIT uses relative (cross-sectional) prediction, not absolute return forecasting.

conditional_prediction.details: H-3 macro regime conditions predictions on macro state, but prediction itself is unconditional within each regime.

event_conditioned_prediction.details: No predictions conditioned on specific events (earnings, macro releases, corporate actions).

short_horizon_1_day.details: LAB-006 only computed for H-5. No 1-day horizon tested.
short_horizon_1_day.feasibility: Can be computed from existing OHLCV data

short_horizon_2_day.feasibility: Can be computed from existing data

medium_horizon_10_day.feasibility: Can be computed from existing data

long_horizon_20_day.feasibility: Can be computed from existing data

long_horizon_60_day.feasibility: Can be computed from existing data

horizon_mismatch_analysis.hypothesis: Macro regime information (low-frequency, monthly/quarterly updates) may be better suited to longer horizons than the 5-day prediction window currently used.
horizon_mismatch_analysis.evidence: H-3 uses FRED macro data (monthly release frequency, quarterly for some). Predicting 5-day returns from monthly macro updates creates a frequency mismatch.
horizon_mismatch_analysis.test_proposal: Recompute targets for H-10, H-20 horizons and test H-3 macro regime features against longer horizons
horizon_mismatch_analysis.prior_evidence: Phase 15.2 temporal instability (val IC negative, test IC positive) may partly reflect horizon mismatch

target_formulation_audit.LAB_005_defect: Excess return calculated vs individual stock historical mean — introduced bias
target_formulation_audit.LAB_006_correction: Excess return calculated vs equal-weight universe median — correct formulation
target_formulation_audit.current_status: LAB-006 is correct and should be retained
target_formulation_audit.remaining_concern: Cross-sectional median subtraction removes market beta but does not control for sector or factor exposures
